   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 19, 2026 - Nov 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _G Dog 03_, Nov 3, 2026, 1/5: "They closed my chat without resolving the issue. I had an error saying that my phone number is already associated with an email. I only have 1 email and for some reason, my phone number is associated with a “private relay Apple email address” they said they would update my original account but never confirmed they actually did it and closed the chat before solving my issue. I logged out and logged back in and I’m still having the same issues as before."
            2. _Lucía Loreto_, Oct 6, 2026, 1/5: "I had to contact them 3 times to freeze my account and yet they failed. I’m injured and can’t use the credits. They keep me on hold and don’t end up doing their job"
            3. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
